map.税额 = 计税余值 × 税率 使用指南: Tax = Taxable Remainder x Rate User Guide
map.输入房产原值、扣除比例与税率（或从租计征的租金收入与税率），计算应纳房产税，支持: Enter the original property value, the deduction ratio and the rate (or the rental income and rate for rental-based taxation) to compute property tax payable, supporting both ad valorem (remainder x rate) and rental-based methods for estimating tax on held property.
map.按房产原值扣除比例后的余值计征（或从租计征）。: Tax on the remainder after the deduction ratio of the original value (or taxed on rent).
map.按房产原值 × 年税率测算 annual 房产税。: Compute the annual property tax from the original value x the annual rate.
map.自住与出租（租金）两种计征方式对比。: Comparison of the two methods: self-use versus rental.
map.评估持有多套房产的税负成本。: Assess the tax cost of holding multiple properties.
map.房产原值 80 万、年税率 1.2%: Original property value 800,000 CNY, annual rate 1.2%
map.：年房产税额 = 800000 × 0.012 = 9,600 元；若原值 10: Annual property tax = 800000 x 0.012 = 9,600 CNY; an original value of 1,000,000 CNY gives 12,000 CNY of tax.
map.：若改按租金计征（如 12%），年租金 6 万则税 7200 元，低于从价 96: If taxed on rent instead (say 12%), annual rent of 60,000 CNY gives 7,200 CNY of tax, lower than the 9,600 CNY ad valorem figure.
map.由代扣金额与征收率求代扣代缴税额: Withheld tax from the withholding amount and the levy rate
map.含税 = 价格 × (1 + 税率): Price including tax = price x (1 + tax rate)
map.由缴费基数与社保费率求社保费: Social insurance contribution from the contribution base and the rate
map.由应税数量与单位税额求从量税: Quantity tax from the taxable quantity and the unit tax
map.从价与从租如何选？: How Do I Choose Ad Valorem or Rental-Based?
map.自用房产多从价（原值减扣除后×率），出租房产从租，具体以当地细则为准。: Self-use property is usually taxed ad valorem (original value minus deductions, times the rate) and rented property on rental income; the local rules govern.
map.是否有免税面积或扣除？: Is There an Exempt Area or Deduction?
map.部分情形对原值有扣除比例或人均免税面积，应以当地政策为准。: In some cases there is a deduction ratio or a per-capita exempt area on the original value; the local policy governs.
